# Bringing the invisible to life

645 Ventures is a New York and San Francisco-based early-stage venture firm that invests in exceptional founders with purity of motivation, earned secrets, and non-consensus thinking.

![Obsessed Problem Solver](https://645ventures.com/founder%20paradigm/Obessed%20Problem%20Solver.svg?dpl=dpl_GxB5YCMYB8s4uKBCsvp9N4jGdZ8B) **Obsessed Problem Solver** \\

![Non-Consensus Thinking](https://645ventures.com/founder%20paradigm/Non-Consensus%20Thinking.svg?dpl=dpl_GxB5YCMYB8s4uKBCsvp9N4jGdZ8B) **Non-Consensus Thinking** \\

Supporting Growth

## How We Help

Perspectives from three of our founders.

![Dave Salvant](https://645ventures.com/testimonials/dave-salvant.png?dpl=dpl_GxB5YCMYB8s4uKBCsvp9N4jGdZ8B)

Customer Acquisition & Retention

> "When the COVID-19 Pandemic hit, small businesses like Squire's customer base of barbershops were left particularly vulnerable. 645 rolled up their sleeves and quickly got to work helping us design a PPP solution for our customers and connecting us with key government officials to help guide reopening policies and set new safety standards."

Dave Salvant

Co-Founder & President, Squire

![Sarah Daccarett](https://645ventures.com/testimonials/sarah-daccarett.png?dpl=dpl_GxB5YCMYB8s4uKBCsvp9N4jGdZ8B)

Go-to-Market Strategy

> "Building a company in the wellness space requires more than capital — it takes partners who genuinely believe in the mission. 645 has been exactly that. From helping us identify the right go-to-market strategy to opening doors with key advisors and distribution partners, their involvement has accelerated our path in ways we couldn't have anticipated. They don't just write checks; they show up."

Sarah Daccarett

Founder & CEO, Inner Balance

![Joe Ariel](https://645ventures.com/testimonials/joe-ariel.png?dpl=dpl_GxB5YCMYB8s4uKBCsvp9N4jGdZ8B)

Fundraising & Round Structuring

> "The 645 Team has been with us since our seed round and provided invaluable support over the course of our Series A & Series B fundraising processes. From brainstorming the right valuation and pitch prep to term negotiations, 645's partnership alleviated some of the pressure so we could focus on what matters."

Joe Ariel

Founder & CEO
